extraction.summary_en: This filing (deposited 30/05/2018) records a 23 March 2018 decision of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES' sole shareholder (HADEAN, represented by Xavier AUMONT) to increase the share capital by incorporation of reserves and free attribution of new shares to HADEAN, and includes the resulting updated statutes (Article 6 "Apports" history and Article 7 "Capital social"). The updated Article 7 shows the capital at €400,000 divided into 400,000 shares of €1, entirely held by HADEAN (holder of category-A preference shares); Article 6 also recaps the company's whole capital history since incorporation (2005-2018).

decision_dates.body: Associée unique (HADEAN, représentée par Xavier AUMONT)

evidence.quote_fr: EN DATE DU 23 MARS 2018 ... La société HADEAN, représentée par Monsieur Xavier AUMONT, Président, en sa qualité d'Associée unique de la société ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES a pris les décisions relatives à l'ordre du jour suivant :

events.date_basis: Date of the sole shareholder's decision (23 mars 2018); the updated statutes attached to this filing already show the resulting capital of €400,000, so the operation is treated as realised here.
events.mechanism: prélèvement sur le poste "Autres Réserves", attribution gratuite à l'associé unique

evidence.quote_fr: L'Associée Unique décide d'augmenter le capital social d'un montant de 182 759 euros par prélèvement sur le poste « Autres Réserves ». En représentation de cette augmentation de capital, il sera créé 182 759 actions nouvelles de 1 euro de valeur nominale, entièrement libérées. ... seront attribuées gratuitement à l'Associé Unique.

events.gloss_en: Sole shareholder decides to increase capital by €182,759 via incorporation of reserves, creating 182,759 new €1 shares attributed free of charge to HADEAN, the sole shareholder.
events.notes: The updated Article 6 and Article 7 of the statutes (p3.5-7, p7.7-9) instead state the increase amount as €185,759, which is inconsistent with the arithmetic (217,241+182,759=400,000, not +185,759). Likely an OCR/drafting error repeated in the statutes; the amount stated in the operative decision (182,759) is used here.

events.date_basis: Date of the AGE recalled in the statutes' 'Apports' history article.

evidence.quote_fr: Aux termes de l'assemblée générale extraordinaire du 17/05/2005, le capital social a été augmenté de 113.000 euros afin d'être porté à 150.000 euros.

events.gloss_en: Historical recap: capital increased by €113,000 to €150,000 on 17/05/2005.

events.date_basis: Date of the AGE recalled in the statutes' 'Apports' history article.

evidence.quote_fr: Aux termes de l'assemblée générale extraordinaire du 20/10/2006, le capital social a été augmenté de 50.000 euros afin d'être porté à 200.000 euros.

events.gloss_en: Historical recap: capital increased by €50,000 to €200,000 on 20/10/2006.

events.date_basis: Date of the AGE recalled in the statutes' 'Apports' history article.

evidence.quote_fr: Aux termes de l'assemblée générale extraordinaire du 27/06/2008, le capital social a été augmenté de 17.241 euros afin d'être porté à 217.241 euros.

events.gloss_en: Historical recap: capital increased by €17,241 to €217,241 on 27/06/2008.

events.date_basis: Date of the AGE recalled in the statutes' 'Apports' history article (same day as previous increase).

evidence.quote_fr: Aux termes de l'assemblée générale extraordinaire du 27/06/2008, le capital social a été augmenté de 150.861 euros afin d'être porté à 368.102 euros.

events.gloss_en: Historical recap: capital increased by €150,861 to €368,102 on 27/06/2008 (second increase that day).

events.date_basis: AGE of 19 January 2017 decided the reduction; realised per Président's decision of 21 February 2017, both recalled in the statutes' history article.

evidence.quote_fr: Aux termes des délibérations de l'Assemblée Générale Extraordinaire en date du 19 janvier 2017 et de décisions du Président en date du 21 février 2017, le capital social a été réduit de 150 861 euros pour être ramené à 217 241 euros par voie de rachat d'actions.

events.gloss_en: Historical recap: capital reduced by €150,861 to €217,241 via share buyback, per AGE of 19/01/2017 and Président's decision of 21/02/2017.

snapshots.as_of_basis: Article 7 of the statutes as updated following the 23 March 2018 sole-shareholder decision.

evidence.quote_fr: Le capital social est fixé à la somme de 400 000 euros. Il est divisé en 400 000 actions de 1 euro chacune entièrement libérées, intégralement détenues par la société HADEAN, titulaire d'actions de préférence de catégorie A.

issues: The two amounts given for the 23 March 2018 capital increase are inconsistent: the operative decision (p2.31-33) and the resulting number of new shares state €182,759, matching the arithmetic (217,241 + 182,759 = 400,000), whereas the updated statutes' recap in Article 6 (p3.5-6) and Article 7's history (p7.7-8) state €185,759, which does not reconcile (217,241 + 185,759 = 403,000 ≠ 400,000). Treated as an OCR/drafting error and the operative amount (182,759) was used for the event.

The 27 June 2008 AGE also carried out a par-value division (nominal divided by 100, capital unchanged at €200,000, shares becoming 200,000 of €1 nominal each) between the two capital increases of that date; per instructions this is not booked as a capital event, only noted here (p6.34-36).

The founding capital (constitution: €37,000, 370 shares of €100, per certificate dated 22/12/2004, statutes signed with full payment on 31/03/2005) is recalled in Article 6 (p6.24-29) but is not emitted as an event/snapshot here since this filing is not the incorporation act.
